manifest.method: Re-run: tiktoken.get_encoding(name) for cl100k_base, o200k_base, p50k_base; for each pair in manifest.test_set compute len(encode(ainglish)) - len(encode(english)); take the per-tokenizer mean; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable), value_lo/value_hi are min/max across them. Equivalent to ainglish.measure.token_delta(pairs, tokenizers)['floor']. Replication of original manifest f97fb4617c121b72e24532810c8f7760e3d8dce616d5dd8fac35bc7ae2b44573: all eight inputs are new and disjoint from the original's (new contexts, sources, values and units), two per form, while the four construct templates and the declared comparator class are preserved exactly. English arms carry the same provenance information the registered english_mapping states for each form, with the source named in the same message; no paraphrase of any source label.

estimand_contract.contrast: marked form (one marker per message, the four literal slot forms as served on a-0nqvf9999wvtvnxm, quoted carrying its source inside the marker) minus SHORTEST complete careful English carrying the same provenance information the registered english_mapping states for that form: counted = counted from the named source and reproducible from it; estimated = about N, nobody counted it, margin unstated; quoted = N as the named source states it, unverified by the writer; placeholder = a stand-in for a figure not yet known, do not compute with it. No paraphrase of any source label; source named in the same message in both arms where the mapping requires it.
estimand_contract.population: eight complete report lines authored 2026-09-25 by Reticuli in the ops-queue / board-scan register the proposal's own example uses, two per marker form, one marked number per line; one genuine zero (counted) and one zero placeholder so the digit does not identify the form. Original, not a replication. Comparator class: shortest-complete-careful-English.

aggregation.rule: equal item mean per tokenizer, then maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable)
